# nb-studio plan

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs from the API document. Do not edit: change the route’s describeRoute() or x-cli, then run `node scripts/gen-cli-reference.mjs`. -->

## plan create

Propose a plan

For people, and for an agent’s run in a person’s conversation (its run token), which acts for that person; a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). The plan is rehearsed and stored pending, for the caller to decide; an agent proposes to the person it acts for, its plan coming from the conversation (`source` left out), and an agent working on an issue is refused (403 `PLAN_SOURCE_FORBIDDEN`). Each row is a `ProjectsPlanRowInput`: `op` and its `params`, and optionally a `ref` later rows use for what it creates. `meta.message` words the outcome.

```bash
nb-studio plan create
```

| Flag            | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------- | ------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `--title`       | string |                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--description` | string |                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--source`      | json   | Where the plan comes from; a newer open plan with the same `key` replaces this one. Required, except from an agent in a conversation, whose plans come from that conversation. |
| `--rows`        | json   |                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `--file`        | path   | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields.                                                                                                              |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.plans/use`.

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/plans` (`projectsCreatePlan`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio plan create --file plan.json
```

## plan execute

Execute a plan

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). Runs every row as the caller, in one transaction; the plan ends executed, `stale` (a target changed since the rehearsal) or `failed`, with nothing applied in the last two cases.

```bash
nb-studio plan execute <plan> --revision <integer>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `plan`   |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description |
| ------------ | ------- | ----------- |
| `--revision` | integer | (required)  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/plans/{planId}/execute` (`projectsExecutePlan`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio plan execute 12 --revision 3
```

## plan get

Get a plan

For people, and for an agent’s run in a person’s conversation (its run token), which acts for that person; a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). Each row with its check and what happened to it.

```bash

```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `plan`   |             |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/plans/{planId}` (`projectsGetPlan`)

## plan list

List plans

For people, and for an agent’s run in a person’s conversation (its run token), which acts for that person; a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). Newest first. Without `issueId`, the plans the caller decides; with it, the plans about that issue the caller may see: those it is the source of and those whose rows change, comment on, link or put a new issue under it, or, once executed, created it. An issue the caller may not see lists none. `status=open` lists the pending, failed and stale ones that have not expired. An agent in a conversation lists that conversation’s plans unless it asks for `all`.

```bash
nb-studio plan list
```

| Flag            | Type    | Description                                                                               |
| --------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--status`      | open \\ | pending \\                                                                                | executing \\ | executed \\ | failed \\ | stale \\ | voided \\ | expired \\ | undone |     |
| `--source-kind` | string  |                                                                                           |
| `--source-key`  | string  |                                                                                           |
| `--issue`       | string  |                                                                                           |
| `--all`         | boolean | From an agent in a conversation: every plan of the person rather than the conversation’s. |
| `--limit`       | integer | (default 20)                                                                              |
| `--page-token`  | string  |                                                                                           |

**Output:** A list (table columns: `id`, `status`, `title`, `source.kind`, `expiresAt`); with `--json`, `result.data` is the array and `result.meta` the paging.

**Who:** People, and agents in a run; needs the action `pm.plans/use`.

**Request:** `GET /api/projects/plans` (`projectsListPlans`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio plan list --status open
```

## plan rehearse

Rehearse a plan without storing it

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). Every row runs for real in a transaction that is rolled back; each gets its check. Each row is a `ProjectsPlanRowInput`: `op` and its `params`, and optionally a `ref` later rows use for what it creates.

```bash
nb-studio plan rehearse
```

| Flag            | Type   | Description                                                       |
| --------------- | ------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--title`       | string |                                                                   |
| `--description` | string |                                                                   |
| `--source`      | json   |                                                                   |
| `--rows`        | json   |                                                                   |
| `--file`        | path   | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/plans/rehearse` (`projectsRehearsePlan`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio plan rehearse --file plan.json
```

## plan retry

Rehearse a failed or stale plan again

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). The plan is pending again when every row passes.

```bash
nb-studio plan retry <plan> --revision <integer>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `plan`   |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description |
| ------------ | ------- | ----------- |
| `--revision` | integer | (required)  |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/plans/{planId}/retry` (`projectsRetryPlan`)

## plan undo

Undo an executed plan

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). By whoever executed it, within 24 hours. With `dryRun: true` answers what undoing would revert and leave alone, changing nothing; otherwise undoes it at once and answers the plan.

```bash
nb-studio plan undo <plan>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `plan`   |             |

| Flag        | Type    | Description                                         |
| ----------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| `--dry-run` | boolean |                                                     |
| `--yes`     | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Undo this plan’s changes?” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/plans/{planId}/undo` (`projectsUndoPlan`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio plan undo 12 --dry-run
nb-studio plan undo 12
```

## plan update

Edit a plan

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). Replaces rows’ params or removes rows, never adds; the plan is rehearsed again.

```bash
nb-studio plan update <plan>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `plan`   |             |

| Flag            | Type    | Description                                                       |
| --------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--revision`    | integer |                                                                   |
| `--title`       | string  |                                                                   |
| `--description` | string  |                                                                   |
| `--rows`        | json    |                                                                   |
| `--file`        | path    | The request body as a JSON object; the flags override its fields. |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `PATCH /api/projects/plans/{planId}` (`projectsEditPlan`)

**Examples:**

```bash
nb-studio plan update 12 --file changes.json
```

## plan void

Void a plan

For people only: a scoped API key or an organization’s API key is refused (403 `SCOPED_KEY_FORBIDDEN`). By its decider.

```bash
nb-studio plan void <plan> --revision <integer>
```

| Argument | Description |
| -------- | ----------- |
| `plan`   |             |

| Flag         | Type    | Description                                                       |
| ------------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--revision` | integer | (required)                                                        |
| `--yes`      | boolean | Go ahead without asking “Void this plan? Nothing in it will run.” |

**Output:** One record, field by field; with `--json`, `result.data`.

**Who:** People (a sign-in or an API key).

**Request:** `POST /api/projects/plans/{planId}/void` (`projectsVoidPlan`)
